located_at.description: Subject is located at object. Also covers 'located in'.

parent_of.description: Subject is a parent or predecessor of object.

associated_with.description: Subject has an explicit association with object. Also covers 'connected to'.

sibling_of.description: Subject and object are siblings (e.g. brother/sister of).

loved.description: Subject and object share a romantic history.

led_by.description: Subject (a group) is led by object. Also covers 'leads' in the reverse direction.

part_of.description: Subject is a constituent part of object (finer-grained than member_of).

opposes.description: Subject and object are in ideological or political opposition, short of open war.

supports.description: Subject backs or supports object without necessarily being a full ally.
